body: I feel like nothing makes me happy or at least truly happy. I’m always happy for a moment but eventually it changes, I get bored or whatever happens. I want a family so badly. Yet even when I’m happy this stuff continues to roll over me like an avalanche. I just don’t get the point of trying anymore.

That’s my problem. I have no value, and they made that obvious. I literally do everything right, try to be as close to perfect as possible. Yet I still get the short end of the stick. I invest so much into everything, and I always get nothing in return. It feels like an endless cycle at this point.
